content.comment_body: Hello, I need to activate and stop a module from an HMI panel. I want to monitor the status of the output as well as the input. I read forum posts, but most only discuss analog signals. I hope someone can assist me. Sorry, my English is not fluent.
Hi, Perhaps you're aware of this information: [url] For digital inputs, outputs, or markers, you should address them as follows:

If you're having trouble activating a digital signal from an HMI to the module, consider the following: - Use HMI software version [version_no] - Inputs and outputs should be addressed directly from the HMI - Declare digital signals within the HMI's variable table - For the module, set the TSAP to 02.00 - Enable server connection - Activation can be done through the operator panel - Enter the IP address of the HMI under remote properties and set TSAP to 02.00. I hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are working to set up activation and monitoring of digital I/O between a module and an HMI panel. They encounter configuration and communication issues, as most available resources address analog signals. There is a clear need for step-by-step guidance focused on digital I/O setup.
analysis.user_expectations: User looks for specific instructions to configure the HMI for controlling and reading digital I/Os on the module, seeking to overcome confusion caused by documentation primarily addressing analog variables.
